title: I have been created and working using "AI" on Push Battle 3D v0.1.0 Released! 🚀 Blast Rivals Off the Clouds!
author: PriorityNo2003
selftext:
Hey everyone! 👋

I'm super excited to share[**Push Battle**](https://gamejolt.com/games/Pushbattle/1104225)—an action-packed 3D physics gladiator arena battle game suspended high above the clouds! ☁️⚔️

Step into the arena as a customizable gladiator warrior, charge your kinetic strike, unleash game-changing superpower abilities, and blast your rivals off floating battle grounds into the abyss!

# 🌟 Key Features:

* **12 Floating Battle Ground Worlds:** Explore dynamic environments from Mossy Ruins and Volcanic Calderas to Frozen Isles and the Apex Citadel.
* **Physics-Driven Combat:** Master kinetic pushes, directional rocket dashes, and edge balance recoveries.
* **5 Upgradable Powers:** Use Mega Push, Energy Shield, Kinetic Shockwave, Giant Mode, and Edge Teleport Recovery to turn the tide.
* **Multiplayer & Custom Rooms:** Jump into real-time online multiplayer matches or set up custom room codes with friends!
* **Deep Customization:** Unlock unique warriors, outfits, mythical hats, and expressive emotes.

Give it a try, let me know what you think in the comments, and don't forget to follow the project page for future updates!

👉 Play it now on Game Jolt:[**Push Battle**](https://gamejolt.com/games/Pushbattle/1104225)
